site.description: Ultrasonic radar sensor on the Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj Bridge over the Panchganga River, Kolhapur. Monitors real-time water stage at the primary urban crossing. Alert thresholds referenced to Rajaram KT Weir MSL datum (WRD Maharashtra).

steps.step_name: Dynamic Subbasin Station Selection & Volume Evaluation (S1–S9)
Spatial Great-Circle Fallback for Ungauged Catchments
Direct Runoff Simulation & SCS-CN Loss Method
Muskingum River Flowpath Routing & Reach Transformation
Shivaji Bridge MSL Stage-Discharge Rating Conversion
Rajaram K.T. Weir Hydraulic Stage-Discharge Conversion
River Flood Threshold & Early Warning Evaluation
